messages:
Maya: Quick poll: who's in for a grocery run after standup? Coffee supplies dwindling and the oat milk carton looks sad. :coffee:
Owen: I'm game. Can we add a 'mug census' sticky on the shelf? Half the mugs are unlabelled and they've been disappearing.
Rina: Also can someone replace the salt shaker? It's more of a sand texture now. :grimacing:
Carlos: I found a secret drawer of mini chocolate bars. Left them on the communal shelf. No tags though so eat at your own risk. :chocolate_bar:
PantryBot: Current stock summary: beans=1_bag; instant_coffee=3_pkts; whole_bean=0; oat_milk=0.3L; sugar=low; salt=empty; mugs_unlabeled=6.
Maya: Thanks PantryBot. Owen, if you can pick up oat milk and a replacement salt shaker that would be awesome. Also maybe a pack of labeled sticker dots so people can mark mugs.
Owen: On it. Leaving in 20. Any preference on oat milk brand? Barista-friendly if possible.
Rina: Oatly or Minor Figures are my vote. Also please grab the medium roast beans if you see them.
Carlos: Re: mugs, can we agree to a 'two week claim' rule? If someone's mug sits unlabeled for more than 2 weeks we put it in Lost & Found box.
Liam: Support the rule. Lost a travel mug and never found it :sob:
Maya: Let's try the rule. I'll make a little sign for the shelf. Can someone set a recurring calendar reminder for 'kitchen tidy' every Friday at 4pm?
PantryBot: Action logged: grocery_run_requested by Owen at 1782509900. Reminder_set_request noted.
Owen: Picking up: oat_milk x3, medium roast beans 1_bag, salt_shaker 1, sticker_dots 1_pack. I'll drop invoice in #finance when I get back.
Rina: Thank you! Also leaving a bag of granola bars I found in my backpack for communal.
Maya: You're the best. If anyone wants to adopt an unlabeled mug before Friday shout now. Otherwise mugs -> Lost & Found box.
Carlos: I'll claim the speckled blue one.
Liam: Whoever claimed my travel mug, you have good taste. :laughing:
